name: performance

check.cmd: ACTUAL_USER="${SUDO_USER:-$USER}" && ACTUAL_HOME="$(eval echo ~$ACTUAL_USER)" && PYTHON_VERSION="$(python3 -c 'import sys; print("{}.{}".format(sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor))' 2>/dev/null || echo '3.10')" && USER_SITE="$ACTUAL_HOME/.local/lib/python$PYTHON_VERSION/site-packages" && (python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '$USER_SITE'); import rdk_performance_node" > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo installed || echo uninstall)

install: pip show rdk_performance_node > /dev/null 2>&1 || (pip install rdk_performance_node -i http://archive.d-robotics.cc/simple/ --trusted-host archive.d-robotics.cc || pip install rdk_performance_node)
uninstall: (pip3 uninstall rdk_performance_node -y 2>/dev/null || pip uninstall rdk_performance_node -y) && echo 'Performance Node 卸载完成'
launch: ACTUAL_USER="${SUDO_USER:-$USER}" && ACTUAL_HOME="$(eval echo ~$ACTUAL_USER)" && PYTHON_VERSION="$(python3 -c 'import sys; print("{}.{}".format(sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor))' 2>/dev/null || echo '3.10')" && USER_SITE="$ACTUAL_HOME/.local/lib/python$PYTHON_VERSION/site-packages" && sudo env PATH="$ACTUAL_HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" PYTHONPATH="$USER_SITE" python3 -m rdk_performance_node.app --port 7999

description.zh: Performance Node：Web 硬件监控节点，实时监控 RDK 设备的 CPU、BPU、内存、磁盘和温度等硬件信息，支持性能模式切换。支持设备：RDK X3/X3 Module/X5/Ultra/S100。通过 pip 包安装，然后通过 http://设备IP:7999 访问。
description.en: Performance Node: Web-based hardware monitoring node for real-time monitoring of RDK device CPU, BPU, memory, disk, and temperature, with performance mode switching support. Supported devices: RDK X3/X3 Module/X5/Ultra/S100. Installed via pip package, then access via http://deviceIP:7999.
